purpose: Demonstrate ecosystem breadth via an auto-scrolling strip of AI-tool integration logos (MCP connector positioning).

motion.detail: continuous scrollLeft += ~30px/s, only while intersecting; per-tile scale 0.59-1.0 by distance from viewport center via cosine falloff; pauses on pointer-down drag
motion.reducedMotionFallback: no autoscroll, no per-tile scaling; static row

connectorLogos.licensing: 11 real trademarked tool logos (Bolt, Figma, Manus, Replit, OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Tasklet, v0, Duckbill) — reuse exactly, never fabricate a fake integration partner.
